candidates.summary: the sponsor-first refund only nets frees against deposits locked earlier in the same tx, so a sponsored setter that grows in one 0-fee tx and shrinks in the next moves the sponsor's deposit to the signer at zero cost
candidates.failure_scenario: Realm ss_payer with Pay(cur){PayGas(5e6,cur); PayStorage(1e6,cur)} and one setter SetN(cur, n) that rebuilds a slice of n strings, no delete function. tx1 (0-fee): Pay + SetN(24): the sponsor locks 288500ugnot, user1 balance unchanged. tx2 (0-fee): Pay + SetN(0): psi.SpentDeposit is 0, so sponsorShare = min(unlocked, 0) = 0 and the else branch refunds the whole 287500ugnot to the signer. user1 goes from 1000000000ugnot to 1000287500ugnot having paid nothing in either tx; the sponsor goes from 10000000 to 9707842ugnot. Any sponsored setter whose value can shrink (a bio, a list, a map entry overwritten with a smaller one) is a free, so the PayStorage doc's 'nor let callers free what it sponsored' rules out every such setter, which the body's Open item does not picture; the loop repeats until the sponsor is empty. Applies while ugnot is unrestricted (restricted refunds go to StorageFeeCollector).

candidates.summary: StorageDepositEvent (and StorageUnlockEvent) carry no payer, so when the sponsor pays the deposit gnokey tells the signer it paid the storage fee, and a sponsor-first refund is reported as the signer's refund
candidates.failure_scenario: 0-fee tx Pay + SetN(24) on a PayStorage sponsor: lockStorageDeposit debits psi.RealmAddr, but the event emitted at keeper.go:2488 is the same {bytes_delta, fee_delta, pkg_path} as a caller-paid deposit. gno.land/pkg/keyscli/root.go:81-89 sums it into 'STORAGE FEE: 288500ugnot' and 'TOTAL TX COST: 288500ugnot' for user1, whose balance did not move. Indexers and wallets reading the event attribute the deposit to the signer; the same holds for the StorageUnlockEvent of a refund that went to the sponsor via sponsorShare. The signer cannot tell the wrong cost from the right one.
